title: alchemilla hybrida subsp. hirsuticaulis
intro: Alchemilla hybrida subsp. hirsuticaulis, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial plant species in the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including menstrual disorders and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory, astringent, and soothing properties. The therapeutic actions of lady's mantle include its ability to reduce bleeding, promote wound healing, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The health benefits of using lady's mantle include its potential to reduce menstrual cramps, alleviate symptoms of menopause, and provide antioxidant protection.
